query:
SELECT
                bp.id,
                bp.account_id,
                bp.board_id,
                bp.icon,
                -- Use get_i18n_string for title, content, and location translations with fallback
                get_i18n_all_string_translations(bp.title) AS title,
                get_i18n_all_string_translations(bp.content) AS content,
                get_i18n_all_string_translations(bp.content_plain) AS content_plain,
                get_i18n_all_string_translations(bp.content_html) AS content_html,
                get_i18n_all_string_translations(bp.location) AS location,
                bp.event_from,
                bp.event_to,
                bp.created_at
            FROM
                board_posts bp
            LEFT JOIN board_group_perms bgp ON bp.board_id = bgp.board_id
            LEFT JOIN account_group_memberships agm ON bgp.group_id = agm.group_id
            WHERE bp.id = $1 AND (bp.visibility IN ('public', 'logged_in') OR (bgp.perm >= 'view' AND agm.account_id = $2) OR account_role_exists($2, 'board_manager'::app_role))
